The details of the same shall be available on the NSE website (http://www.nseindia.com) under: Corporates > Latest Announcements and on the Extranet Server (/Common/Corporate Announcements). For more details click here.

Rural Electrification Corporation Limited has informed the Exchange that "There has been a change in the Composition of the Board of Directors due to appointment of Shri P. Uma.Shankar as CMD in place of Shri A.K. Lakhina vide order dated 29th February, 2008 passed by the President of India, in terms of the Articles of Association of REC Ltd."

Rural Electrification Corporation Limited has informed the Exchange that "Corporation would be publishing Audited Financial Results for the year ended 31st March, 2008 within 3 months from the end of the last quarter i.e. on or before 30.06.2008. The Corporation will therefore not be publishing or furnishing to the Stock Exchange the Unaudited Results for the last quarter of the Financial Year ended 31st March, 2008."
